reviewItem.question: For "OperatorHub Packages Discontinued: We no longer publish OperatorHub packages for cert-manager", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether cert-manager is installed and upgraded through an OperatorHub/OLM package (RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub or operatorhub.io) rather than Helm or static manifests

proposed.statement: cert-manager no longer publishes OperatorHub packages; v1.16.5 is the last cert-manager release on OperatorHub (RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub and operatorhub.io), and the cert-manager-olm repository is archived.
